item: A feed language tag the article's own script refutes is cleared and re-deduced (R699 cause 1, Lane V)
key_paths: src/analytics/script_check.py; src/analytics/store.py; src/analytics/engine_identity.py; configs/indexer_pin.json; configs/www_indexer_pin.json; tests/test_language_tag_script_check.py
summary: The 2026-10-06 triage found Russian news tagged en (новости: 2,087 of 2,094 articles tagged English), so Russian function words became English keywords. _resolve_known_language now counts the letters' writing system (first 5,000 characters, at least 100 letters): when under 25% are in the asserted language's own script, the tag is cleared and the article goes through the offline detector like an untagged one (a confident language or honestly unknown). Only single-script languages are judged; Serbian and other two-script languages, unknown codes and short bodies never are; French tagged English is not caught (same script). Runs at ingest and on re-index; Markup is stripped before counting; INDEXER_VERSION 1 to 2 (places and entities do not read the language, so the www stamp stays). Old rows converge only after a re-index.
